routes.name: Residence as Rentista
routes.summary: Residence for people with steady income from abroad or Honduras. Applied for through the Secretariat of Governance, Justice and Decentralization.

income.note: Or equivalent in lempiras, permanent and stable

other: Criminal record from home country, apostilled and translated into Spanish
Honduran court and police (DPI) record certificates
Medical certificate from the Colegio Medico de Honduras, dated within 6 months
Migration movement certificate from the INM

sources.label: Honduras SGJD, requirements for Rentista residence

routes.name: Residence as Pensionado
routes.summary: Residence for retirees with a foreign pension paid into a Honduran bank.

income.note: Permanent pension from abroad, or equivalent in lempiras, paid through the Honduran financial system

other: Criminal record from home country, apostilled and translated into Spanish
Honduran court and police (DPI) record certificates
Medical certificate from the Colegio Medico de Honduras, dated within 6 months
Migration movement certificate from the INM

sources.label: Honduras SGJD, requirements for Pensionado residence

routes.name: Residence by Marriage or Recognized Union
routes.summary: For foreigners married to, or in a recognized de facto union with, a Honduran. The page says residence is available three years after the marriage or union.

other: Marriage certificate or proof of union from the National Registry of Persons

sources.label: Honduras SGJD, requirements for marriage or union residence

routes.name: Residence by Family Tie
routes.summary: Residence based on a family relationship. The official page does not say which relatives qualify, so confirm with the Secretariat.

other: Proof of the family tie plus birth certificate
Which relationships qualify is not stated on the page, confirm with the authority

sources.label: Honduras SGJD, requirements for family tie residence
